PROSPECTUS 2025 – 26
         NONOI COLLEGE


                         IN LOVING MEMORY OF SAGAR SUBEDI




                                 ( 27th February, 1968– 12th January 2025)

       We pay heartfelt tribute to the late Sagar Subedi, a revered educator, visionary leader, and beloved
former Principal of our college. He dedicated his life to the pursuit of knowledge, serving as Assistant
Professor in the Department of History and later guiding the institution with wisdom and compassion as
Principal.

       His dynamic teaching style brought history alive, inspiring generations of students to think critically
and embrace cultural heritage. His dedication to academic excellence played a pivotal role in the college’s
remarkable achievement of a higher grade in the NAAC accreditation, setting new benchmarks for quality
education.

       Sagar Subedi’s profound commitment extended beyond the classroom. As a prominent figure of the
Gurkha community, he championed inclusivity, cultural pride, and social welfare, becoming a beacon of
hope and inspiration. Under his leadership, the college flourished as a nurturing space for learning, growth,
and community engagement.

       His legacy endures in the hearts of students, colleagues, and the wider community. We honor his
remarkable journey, his unwavering dedication, and his lasting impact on education and society. This
prospectus stands as a testament to his life’s work and a tribute to a life well-lived.




                                                                        Prospectus(2025-26) Nonoi College
        NONOI COLLEGE




                     IN LOVING MEMORY OF PADMAKANTA BORA




                              (27th January,1955 – 1st December,2024)
        We extend our heartfelt tribute to Padmakanta Bora, a beloved member of Nonoi College and one of
its esteemed founding staffs. Mr. Bora served the institution with unwavering dedication as 4th Grade staff,
becoming an inseparable part of its journey from humble beginnings to its present stature.

        For Mr. Bora, Nonoi College was not merely a workplace—it was his first home. His tireless
commitment, humility, and sense of responsibility made him a beloved figure among students, teachers, and
staff. Always ready with a smile and helping hand, he played a vital role in nurturing a supportive,
welcoming environment on campus. He was the founder president of ―Gyanjyoti sakha Sahitya Sabha‖ of
the College

       Throughout his life, he exemplified the values of sincerity, kindness, and loyalty. Even after his
formal retirement, his heart remained with the college, continuing to contribute in small yet meaningful
ways. His work ethic and dedication left an indelible mark on the college community.

        His passing is deeply felt, yet his legacy endures in the many lives he inspired and influenced. This
prospectus is dedicated to honoring his life of quiet service, his contributions to Nonoi College, and his
everlasting presence in our collective memory.

                                     NONOI COLLEGE


       Nonoi College envisions to establish itself as an institution of excellence and strives towards
producing individuals who are knowledgeable, competent, far-sighted and sensitive to the needs of society
and the environment. It further envisages to instill in them moral and ethical values, equip them with life
skills and critical thinking so that they can explore their creative potential, find gainful employment and turn
out to be engaged, productive, and contributing citizens for building an equitable, inclusive, and plural
society as envisaged by our Constitution.




      To fulfil the academic needs of the students, especially those belonging to economically and
        socially disadvantaged sections and to empower them with quality education and employability
        skills.
      To give a fillip to women’s education and empowerment.
      To sensitize the students on socio-economic issues with emphasis on gender issues, human rights
        and environmental concerns through extension activities and co-curricular activities such as sports
        and games, cultural activities and youth festival, literary activities, seminar etc.
      To foster research with social relevance and to provide value based and skill-oriented education to
        the rural students to make them confident, self-reliant, and productive members of our society.
      To promote use of ICT aided teaching so that the students can get exposure to the latest
        advancement in technology.
      To inculcate among students the quality of honesty, integrity, creativity, self-discipline and
        simplicity.
      To help the students discover their inherent potentials and shape them as future leaders.




      To impart higher education in the discipline of Arts.
      To help students to bring out the best in them so that they can make use of their training in real life
        situations.
      To develop their spirit of patriotism, dedication and service to the nation.

                                                               WELCOME MESSAGE
                                                              FROM THE PRINCIPAL



                              विद्यायाां रत्नमालाभ्ाां शोभते, गौहत्ाां नोनोया महाविद्यालयः ।
                                    तत्त्वां प्रकाशयन् जन्तून् विद्याधानां समृद्धिभूयसा॥

                    Which significe in the necklace of knowledge, Nonoi College shines brightly,
                   Illuminating truths for all beings, enriching them with the wealth of education.
        With Great honour and reverence, we invoke the divine blessings of knowledge and wisdom as we embark on
a journey of transformation and empowerment through education at Nonoi College. As the Principal, I am deeply
committed to ensuring that every individual in our community has access to quality education and opportunities for
personal growth and development. I am thrilled to share with you some remarkable developments that are shaping the
future of our institution and, by extension, the future of our community. Nonoi College is proud to align itself with the
visionary National Education Policy (NEP) Four Year Undergraduate Programme (FYUGP) of Gauhati University.
This strategic alignment reflects our commitment to providing inclusive, relevant, and empowering education that
meets the needs and aspirations of our rural youth.
         The NEP FYUGP is not just a curriculum; it is a blueprint for holistic development, multidisciplinary
learning, and skill enhancement. It empowers students to explore their interests, hone their talents, and acquire the
knowledge and skills necessary to thrive in an ever-evolving world. At Nonoi College, we are dedicated to
implementing the principles and goals of the NEP FYUGP to ensure that every student receives a comprehensive and
enriching educational experience. In addition to embracing the NEP FYUGP, I am proud to announce that Nonoi
College has recently achieved accreditation from the National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC) with a
commendable B++ grade. This accreditation is a testament to our unwavering commitment to academic excellence,
quality teaching, and innovative practices. It reaffirms our dedication to providing a conducive learning environment
that nurtures the intellectual, emotional, and social growth of our students. To our rural community members, I want
to emphasize that Nonoi College is your institution. It is a place where your dreams and aspirations can take root and
flourish. Whether you aspire to pursue higher education, enhance your skills, or embark on a new career path, Nonoi
College is here to support you every step of the way. In the pages of our prospectus, you will find a comprehensive
overview of the diverse academic programs, extracurricular activities, and support services offered at Nonoi College. I
invite you to explore these opportunities and discover how our institution can serve as a springboard for your
academic and personal aspirations.
         In closing, I extend my heartfelt gratitude to our dedicated faculty, staff, students, and supporters whose
unwavering commitment and passion continue to propel Nonoi College towards excellence. As we strive to uphold
our commitment to academic excellence and student-centric education, I encourage all stakeholders to actively engage
in the journey ahead. Together, let us nurture a culture of inquiry, innovation, and inclusivity that empowers every
individual to realize their full potential.
                                                                                                With warm regards,

                                                                                                  (Rita Sarmah)

                 A SUCCINCT OVERVIEW OF NONOI COLLEGE
         Nonoi College, nestled in the heart of the greater Nonoi area, is a beacon of hope for rural youth aspiring
for higher education. We are thrilled to announce our recent accreditation by the National Assessment and
Accreditation Council (NAAC), receiving a distinguished B++ grade. This achievement underscores our
dedication to maintaining high standards of education and academic excellence Established in 1985 through the
concerted efforts of local visionaries, the college has emerged as a symbol of educational excellence and
community empowerment. Nevertheless, through the dedication of its founding faculty and the backing of the
Governing Body, it overcame challenges and emerged triumphant. With a strong commitment to fostering
holistic development and academic growth, Nonoi College stands as a testament to the resilience and
determination of its founders and stakeholders. Guided by the motto "Atmadipa Bhava," which translates to "Be
your own light," the college instills in its students the values of self-reliance, perseverance, and intellectual
enlightenment. Through a diverse range of programs and initiatives, Nonoi College continues to inspire
generations of learners to realize their full potential and contribute meaningfully to society. Located along
National Highway 36, linking Guwahati and Silchar, the college enjoys excellent road connectivity with Nagaon,
the nearest district headquarters town, just 10 km away. With an ideal educational environment, Nonoi College
attracts students primarily from agricultural backgrounds, driven by a strong desire for higher education.
Targeting the rural poor, first-generation learners, marginalized groups, and women in particular, the college
prioritizes quality education. It aims to increase enrollment, especially among female students, viewing education
as a pathway to unlock individuals' latent potential and foster achievement through learning and self-realization.
         Nonoi College is affiliated with Gauhati University, boasting permanent affiliation for courses in
Assamese, English, Economics, Political Science, Education, and History, alongside temporary affiliation for
Geography, Psychology, and Folklore. Notably, it was the first degree college in the state to introduce
Psychology program. Having gained government approval in 1995-96 as an affiliated college under Gauhati
University, Nonoi College is recognized by the UGC under sections 2(f) and 12(b). Governed by a duly
constituted governing body, oversight is provided by the Director of Higher Education, Assam.
         Nonoi College has recently launched NC News, a platform that provides all the latest updates. Operating
as a single Arts stream undergraduate (UG) co-educational institution, Nonoi College boasts a higher proportion
of female students.

     ELIGIBILITY FOR ADMISSION
        Admission to T.D.C. 1st Semester class in open for those who have passed H.S. (10+2) standard
examinations conducted by Assam Higher Secondary Education Council or Central Board of Secondary
Education (CBSE) or any other equivalent examinations.
        The application will have to submit along with attested photocopy of marksheet and certificates at
the time of application. They will have to produce the original copies of the certificate and marksheet at the
time of admission.

  COLLEGE UNIFORM

       Boys: White Shirt and Black Trousers.
       Girls: i) Muga or Muga Coloured Mekhela. White blouse and Chadar with Blue border or
                ii) White Salwar Kamieez and Blue Surni.
               iii) It is compulsory for the girls to wear mekhela-chadar on every Monday & Thursday.
N.B.: Every Student will have to wear Black Shoes. In winter Season they will have to wear Navy-blue
      Sweater or coat.

ATTENDANCE
       i)         To be eligible to appear in each semester final examination, a student must attend minimum
                  classes in each individual subject as under- Minimum 75% and above: Eligible for the
                  Examination.
       ii)        Scholarship holders with less than 75% attendance may be deprived of the scholarship.


Students Union
       Nonoi college student's union is the general body of students of the college and all the students are
the member of the union. The election of Nonoi College student's union is held as per guide lines of
Lyngdoh committee and The Honourable Supreme Court of India. Dated 22-09-2006. The guidelines are
follows –
       1) Under Graduate students between the ages of 17 and 22, Only can contest the election.
       2) The candidates should in no event have any academic arrears in the year of contesting the election.
       3) The candidate should have the minimum percentage of attendance in classes as prescribed by the
             university of 75% attendance, whichever is higher.
       4) The candidates shall not have previous criminal record. The candidates shall also not have been
             subject to any disciplinary action by the college authority.
       5) The candidate must be a regular full-time student of the college.

IDENTITY CARD
       Identity Cards will be issued to Students of TDC, First, Third & Fifth Semester Classes. The students
of other Classes will have to renew the identity Cards every Six Months after admission. The students must
keep the Identity Cards with them during College hours and produce them on demand by the Principal or
any Assistant Professors of the College. They will have to surrender their identity Cards at the time of issue
of Marksheet/Certificate of the final examination.

   COLLEGE EXAMINATION

        There will be one sessional exam and one end semester exam in each semester, Sessional exam will
be conducted by college and end semester exam will be conducted by G.U. TDC Semester System: 20% of
total marks comes from internal assessment/evaluation and rest from end Semester evaluation. There Shall
be at least one Sessional examination in each Semester. Pass Mark is 40%, If anybody fails in internal
assessment then he will be declared fail even he/she scores pass mark in the last semester evaluation.

   ONLINE FORM FILL UP FOR ADMISSION

        Nonoi College has made all admission online from the Session 2020-21, in Keeping with the Govt.
order, Applicants have to visit the website www.nonoicollege.in and Click at the 'Online Admission' button.
There will be elaborate instructions about how to register, pay fees and Submit admission form in the
website and students have to follow them accordingly.


            FOUR-YEAR UNDERGRADUATE PROGRAMME (FYUGP) UNDER GAUHATI
            UNIVERSITY
        Nonoi College proudly offers the Four-Year Undergraduate Programme (FYUGP) under Gauhati
University, aligned with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020. This innovative programme provides
flexibility and academic excellence through multiple entry and exit points. Students can earn a Certificate
after one year, a Diploma after two years, a Bachelor’s degree after three years, and a Bachelor’s degree
with Honours or Honours with Research after four years.
        The FYUGP follows an interdisciplinary approach, encouraging students to explore various subjects
beyond their core discipline.
        Emphasizing skill development and practical learning, the programme integrates research projects,
internships, and skill enhancement courses to prepare students for diverse career paths. It offers
specialization opportunities in Arts and Science streams, fostering critical thinking, creativity, and lifelong
learning.
        At Nonoi College, the FYUGP equips students with holistic education, blending academic depth
with flexibility to meet the evolving demands of higher education and employment.

and health based in India. It is a part of the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement, and so

 RED RIBBON CLUB

       The Red Ribbon Club is a voluntary on-campus intervention program for students in educational
institutions. It is initiated and supported by the State AIDS Control Society and implemented through multi-
sectorial collaboration.

       The Red Ribbon Club in the educational institutions seek to initiate efforts to educate youth with
correct, concise and adequate information and heighten their level of awareness HIV/AIDS/STI/sexuality
and other related issues. It also enables youth, especially the female students to identify and understand
situations of exploitation and abuse. It tries to sensitise the youth and instill in them the spirit of helping and
supporting people living with HIV/AIDS and reduce the stigma and discrimination against them. The RRC
increases youths' access to health care services related to STI/HIV/AIDS/drug use.

       The key areas of RRC are to motivate youth and build their capacity as peer educators by developing
their skills on leadership, negotiation and team building. It also aims to promote voluntary non-remunerated
blood donation among youth.

       The Red Ribbon Club, Nonoi College, Nagaon (Assam) was formed in the month of April 2018.

       The main aim of the Red Ribbon Club of the college is to educate and well-train the students through
awareness camp, seminar regarding positive and safer healthy behavior.

 Programmes offered in line with NEP 2020(Arts)

   1. Bachelor's Degree in Arts with Major/Honors in Assamese

   4. Bachelor's Degree in Arts with Major/Honors in Political Science

 Multiple Exit and Entry Points:

           Under the undergraduate program at Gauhati University, multiple exit and entry points are
   allowed at specific stages of the program. As per the NEP 2020, students have the option to exit the
   program and receive appropriate certifications after completing the 3rd, 5th, and 7th semesters. This
   provision offers flexibility to students who may choose to enter the workforce or pursue further
   studies after completing a certain number of semesters. By allowing multiple exit points, Gauhati
   University pro- motes inclusivity and recognizes diverse career trajectories for its students.

 Certificate, Diploma and Degree:

          Gauhati University's four-year undergraduate program, following the guidelines of the NEP
   2020, offers different certifications based on the stage of exit for students:

          i. Certificate: If a student chooses to exit the program after completing one year, they will
   receive a Certificate. This certification acknowledges their successful completion of one year of
   undergraduate studies.

         ii. Diploma: If a student decides to exit the program after completing two years, they will be
   awarded a Diploma.

           This certification signifies their completion of two years of undergraduate studies and
   indicates a higher level of proficiency in their chosen field.

            iii. Degree with Major/Without Major: If a student completes three years of the program
   and decides to exit, they will be conferred a Degree in a Stream with or without Major. This degree
   recognizes their completion of the full three-year undergraduate program and signifies their expertise
   in their chosen field of study.

undergraduate program, Gauhati University awards a Degree with Honors or Research. This degree
recognizes their comprehensive education and signifies their excellence in their chosen discipline, as
well as their potential for research or higher studies.
            The multiple exit points and corresponding certifications provided by Gauhati University
accommodate the diverse aspirations and career paths of students, allowing them to receive recognition
for their academic accomplishments at different stages of their undergraduate journey.

university.

       vii. Course Structure and Credits: The undergraduate program at Gauhati University, GU-
FYUGP, consists of two main parts: Core Courses and Common Courses. In a three-year degree
program (with or without a major), a minimum of 84 credits is allocated for Core Courses and 36 credits
for Common Courses. In a four-year degree program, 120 credits are assigned for Core Courses, and 40
credits are allocated for Common Courses. The detailed list of Core and Common courses, along with
the credits assigned to each, can be found in the provided Programmes Offered column.

      Gauhati University's curriculum structure, credit allocation, and flexible options for major change
and double majoring allow students to personalize their education and explore diverse academic path-
ways. These features promote interdisciplinary learning, academic progression, and the acquisition of a
well-rounded skill set.

       viii. ABC: Gauhati University is registered in the Academic Bank of Credit (ABC), which is a
virtual academic mechanism facilitating the mobility of students within and between Higher Educational
In- stitutions (HEIs) across the country. As a result, all students of Nonoi College come under the
purview of the ABC. At the end of each examination in GU-FYUGP, the university deposits all earned
credits into the ABC for each student. To participate in this system, students must obtain an ABC ID
through the Digi locker platform before admission.

      ix. Admission: Prior to admission, students must first obtain an ABC ID. Once they have their
ABC ID, they can proceed with the online admission process through the college's website
(www.nonoicollege.in). Detailed information regarding the admission procedure can be found on the
college's website, providing students with clear guidelines for successfully completing the admission
process.
